Docs.Title: 1.01.030 - References to code.
Docs.Content:
This code shall be known as the code of ordinances of the city of Cheyenne, Wyoming and may be referred to as the Cheyenne city code in any prosecution for the violation of any provision thereof or in any proceeding at law or equity. It will be sufficient to designate any ordinance adding to, amending, correcting or repealing all of any part or portion thereof as an addition to, amendment to, correction or repeal of the Cheyenne city code. References may be made to the titles, chapters, sections and subsections of the Cheyenne city code and references apply to those titles, chapters, sections or subsections as they appear in the code.

(Ord. 3514 § 3, 2003)
